name: llm_token_burn_high
title: Service used over 2M tokens in an hour
description: A service used more than 2,000,000 tokens on model calls in the last 60 minutes. Works when pricing is missing; catches prompt bloat and agent loops. Tune the threshold to your normal hourly use. Needs LLM spans in the traces stream named default; OpenObserve writes the gen_ai columns at ingest.

query_condition.sql: SELECT service_name, SUM(gen_ai_usage_total_tokens) AS tokens FROM "default" WHERE gen_ai_response_model IS NOT NULL AND (gen_ai_operation_name IS NULL OR gen_ai_operation_name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings')) GROUP BY service_name HAVING SUM(gen_ai_usage_total_tokens) > 2000000

row_template: *{service_name}* used {tokens} tokens in the last hour
